build_wav_prompt: build a prompt from a WAV audio file using the Spiritlm model's speech tokenizer
build_text_prompt: build a text prompt with the Spiritlm model's text prompt prefix prepended
test_wav_prompt: test the wav_prompt function by loading a WAV file and tokenizing it with Spiritlm
test_text_prompt: test the text_prompt function by passing a string and verifying the prefix is added
review_utils: review the Spiritlm eval utils module for wav_prompt and text_prompt helper functions
